hooks.name: Auto Commit & Push on File Save
hooks.description: Automatically stages, commits, and pushes any saved source file changes to GitHub so Vercel rebuilds instantly.

action.command: powershell -Command "Set-Location 'c:\Users\mutua\cryptcoin'; $git = 'C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe'; & $git add -A; $diff = & $git diff --cached --quiet; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $ts = Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm:ss'; & $git commit -m "auto: update $ts"; & $git push origin master }"
